subject: Joint Solution Bundle: commission tiers & lead registration process
messages:
From: Andrew Mills <andrew.mills@lumenedge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint bundle idea — margin bands, registration, and MoU

Hi Soojin / Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week. LumenEdge is excited about packaging a joint offering (Redwood runtime + our enterprise integration) for a pilot with one of our telco customers. Before we move to a pilot agreement, a couple of quick commercial questions so we can scope pricing on our side: 

- What revenue-share / margin bands do you typically offer for a co-sold joint solution vs. a straight referral?
- Do you require lead registration for credit, and if so what’s the registration window (days) and the proof you need?
- Any carve-outs around exclusivity we should be aware of for enterprise pilots?

I’ve attached a short MoU and a preliminary pricing grid to show our target TCV and expected deal cadence (see "LumenEdge_MoU_v1.pdf" and "joint-pricing-grid.xlsx"). Would appreciate a quick confirmation on the above so we can finalize the pilot commercials.

If it helps we can do a 30-min sync later this week — what’s your availability?

Best,
Andrew

Subject: Re: Joint bundle idea — margin bands, registration, and MoU

Hi Andrew — thanks for the materials and for outlining the pilot. High-level answers below, happy to jump on a call to walk through specifics: 

- Typical structure: referral = 25% one-time commission on Redwood net revenue for the first 12 months; co-sell / joint solution bundles = revenue-share split (commonly 30/70 partner/platform depending on who owns customer relationship & billing). For pilots we can offer a temporary uplift (e.g., +5pp) if LumenEdge is committing co-marketing and assigned SE resources.
- Lead registration: we use a registration form + deal registration in our partner portal. Standard protection window is 90 days from registration for pipeline credit, extendable to 180 days if a mutual MQL is logged and both parties agree on engagement milestones. We require: (a) registration form submission, (b) minimal qualifying info (company, contact, expected TCV), and (c) a short one-pager describing the proposed bundle.
- Exclusivity: we generally avoid exclusivity for platform partners. For strategic pilots we can discuss short-term limited exclusivity tied to specific accounts, but that requires an exec-level approval and a signed SOW.

Next steps: Camila, can you confirm whether the LumenEdge price grid maps to our SKU model (so we can calculate net revenue), and Ben can help with the partner portal setup and registration workflow if Andrew wants to register the first couple of leads.

Happy to take a 30-min sync Wed afternoon (2–4pm PT) or Thu morning.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com

Thanks Soojin — that’s helpful. A couple of follow-ups: 

- For pilots we were hoping for 120-day protection; 90 is workable but 120 would give our sales team more runway. Is that something we can escalate?
- The deal will go through LumenEdge billing (we will invoice for services + add Redwood as a pass-through). Will that change how you calculate net revenue for commissions?

We can do Wed 3pm PT for a short sync; I’ll invite Simone (our product lead) to the call so she can map integration touchpoints.

Subject: RE: Joint bundle idea — margin bands, registration, and MoU

Hi Andrew — following up after our call yesterday. Quick summary and proposed commercial guardrails to put in the MoU redline I attached: 

- Commission structure:
  • Referral credit: 25% of Redwood net revenue on first 12 months; payment after Redwood invoices the end customer.
  • Co-sell / joint bundle: 30% revenue share to LumenEdge for deals where LumenEdge is the billing owner and Redwood is a subcontracted SaaS provider.
  • Resale (if LumenEdge resells as a packaged SKU): 18% margin-based reseller fee with monthly reconciliation and a 60-day clawback window for credits/returns.

- Lead registration: 90-day standard protection for registered leads via our partner portal. We can extend to 120 days for named accounts tied to a signed SOW or when mutual MQL milestones are logged in the portal. Registration requires minimal qualifying info + one-pager; we’ll provide a registration template and a short onboarding checklist.

- Exclusivity & pilots: No general exclusivity. For pilots targeting a named strategic account, we can negotiate limited account-level exclusivity for the pilot term (max 6 months) subject to exec approval and a signed SOW.

- Billing & net revenue calculation: Net revenue = Redwood net receipts after cloud passthroughs and transaction fees; if LumenEdge invoices and collects, we’ll need a monthly remittance report and an invoice/tax copy to validate commission calculations.

Attached: MoU_redline_v2.pdf (redline reflecting the guarded terms above) and a pricing mapping I exported to align with Redwood SKUs. If this looks good I’ll have Legal send a short SOW template and Ben can set up a partner portal account for LumenEdge so they can file registrations.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Director, Alliances | Redwood Inference
